product_purpose: Apply at most one daily boost to the current mapped Food Farm, preferring one exact matching owned item; only when the matching owned item is positively unavailable may the exact current one-day Food Farm Diamond option be used at or below the 48-Diamond authorization cap after fresh price/balance checks and rechecking an actual confirmation only if one appears.

postconditions: Only the current safely bound mapped Food Farm is entered.
The initial Farm tap may collect output from multiple buildings; FOOD_FARM_FIRST_TAP_SETTLED requires bound Home or the same Farm radial, not collection credit.
The first tap settles on current bound Home or the same Farm radial even when the Food HUD is unchanged or unreadable; preserve its canonical journal identity.
Credit collection only for a positive Food HUD tick; otherwise collection_count is zero. Positive collection is not a boost gate; preserve historical exact collection credit.
Observe exact matching Food Farm item identity, one-day duration, and positive current usability; no inventory census is required.
An action cost of one item is not evidence of total inventory count.
This branch is allowed only when the exact matching owned item is positively usable with matching one-day duration.
Use exactly one item; item-first preference forbids Diamonds when an eligible owned item exists.
This branch is allowed only when the exact matching owned item is positively unavailable; unknown usability never establishes premium eligibility.

Observe the exact current one-day Food Farm option, fresh numeric Diamond price, and current Diamond balance; price must be no more than the 48-Diamond authorization cap and balance must cover the exact observed price.
The cap is not the current price; unknown, changed, or mismatched offer blocks.
Recheck exact current offer, numeric price, and balance before dispatch and if an actual confirmation appears; a changed confirmation blocks and no extra dialog is required.
Buy exactly one matching one-day Food Farm option at or below the 48-Diamond authorization cap, never infer current price from the cap.
Same mapped Food Farm identity positively shows Boosting with a positive current timer.
A purchase/item dispatch or collection output alone is not success proof; reconcile attempt and confirmed counts under the reset identity.
The route-owned source-bound return reaches current canonical Home.

cost_quantity_requirements.notes: Owned matching item is first choice; action cost 1 is not inventory count. The 48-Diamond authorization cap is not the current price; Diamond fallback requires exact observed current price ≤48 when matching owned count is zero, current balance covering that exact price, and confirmation recheck.

cooldown_deferred_behavior: Defer when one boost was already attempted or confirmed this reset, matching usable item and eligible offer are unavailable, or the exact current Diamond balance is insufficient; retain first-tap settlement, positive Food HUD collection credit, and boost effects separately.
bounded_recovery_behavior: Stop before boosting on unknown mapped Farm, unsettled first tap or unknown item usability, item identity/duration, exact current offer/price/balance, changed confirmation, timer successor, reset identity, or Home. Never use Buy Box, Resource Building Boost, global Food Output Boost, real-money confirmation, second boost, or identical retry.
evidence_requirements: Current source-bound native evidence for mapped Farm identity; first-tap settlement on bound Home or the same Farm radial and collection credit only for a positive Food HUD tick; matching item identity/usability/duration; item-first branch; exact eligible current one-day Diamond offer only when the item is positively unavailable, fresh numeric price 1..48, current balance and rechecking any actual confirmation; same-Farm Boosting positive timer; attempt-versus-confirmed persistence; reset identity; and canonical Home.
No native acceptance, capture identifier, or live readiness is asserted.

replay_fixture_requirements.notes: No synthetic fixture substitutes for current Farm first-tap settlement, item usability, exact price/balance, and active timer evidence.

unsupported_or_manual_only_states: item action cost mistaken for inventory count

required_evidence: The complete native evidence set listed in evidence_requirements, including exact collection and boost effect reconciliation.

scenarios.notes: This is a disabled, evidence-gated contract. Product authority lists the only route-owned action classes; this scenario authorizes no runtime input until the native gate is satisfied.
